reviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful
reviews.comment: This Mobo has been an absoloute beast, and is simply stunning. I paired this with 32gb 6000mhz CL30 T force silver ram and a Gigabyte 9070xt, as well as a Aorus AIO, and this may be the prettiest build I have done so far. Board is also easy to upgrade the bios, OC, and get into bios to make any adjustments. I definitly enjoy the ease of getting the graphics card out, and the internal HDMI port is great for the internal monitor I have setup
